description: This file contains a C# class definition for a test grain used in Orleans framework, specifically for journaling and durable state testing. It defines a class 'DurableValueTestGrain' with methods to set and get values, and retrieve an activation ID.

classes.name: DurableValueTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class for Orleans journaling, managing durable values with methods to set and retrieve state.

methods.name: SetValues
methods.description: Sets the durable values for name and counter, then writes state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves the current durable values for name and counter.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the unique activation ID of the grain.
